program: Wingless corrective RSI tranche: mechanism attribution for cross-manifest calibration failure
question: Are R28 sign/scale errors primarily explained by feature extrapolation, historical policy nonstationarity, or domain-level prediction cancellation rather than by lack of ensemble consensus?
hypothesis: Reuse the exact four sealed manifests, R27 six-feature representation, ridge lambda=1 and ten fixed policies. For each outer held-out manifest, before reading its policy outcomes: (A) FEATURE_EXTRAPOLATION is true when the held-out policy delta-feature vector has at least one component outside the min/max range observed for that same policy across the other three manifests; report excursion count and normalized excursion magnitude using training range with 1e-12 floor. (B) HISTORICAL_SIGN_INSTABILITY is true when the three training-manifest actual policy advantages do not share one sign class among {-1,0,+1}; training outcomes are permitted because they are not held-out. (C) DOMAIN_CONTRIBUTION_CONFLICT is true when the main model's three predicted domain-level allocation deltas contain both positive and negative nonzero signs before aggregation. Freeze all three flags for all 40 held-out policy cases, then open held-out actual advantages and compare sign-error rate and MAE between flagged and unflagged cases. This is causal attribution only; no flag changes allocation or confidence policy.

predecessor.eliminated_hypothesis: prediction agreement/spread alone is a sufficient pre-outcome reliability discriminator
predecessor.strengthened_hypothesis: calibration failure may be caused by regime extrapolation and policy nonstationarity rather than uncertainty in the narrow ensemble sense

cause_effect_trace.observed_failure: R28 consensus predicates covered substantial cases but had worse sign accuracy and MAE than ungated predictions; robust lower bound covered none.
cause_effect_trace.internal_diagnostic: same-policy cross-manifest feature position, known training-manifest policy outcomes, and pre-outcome domain-level predicted contributions
cause_effect_trace.frozen_candidate_selection_rule: none; evaluate all three preregistered mechanisms
cause_effect_trace.exact_bounded_delta: derive three diagnostic flags from already-qualified data/model state; no feature/model/allocator/capacity/authority change
cause_effect_trace.qualification: deterministic double replay over exact four manifests; held-out outcomes hidden until flags freeze
cause_effect_trace.held_out_result: sign error and absolute error evaluated after flag freeze
cause_effect_trace.retain_revert: nothing retained or modified in R29
cause_effect_trace.next_hypothesis: supported cause must be converted into one preregistered correction and validated prospectively on a sixth manifest; otherwise inspect outcome-generation mechanism without relaxing confidence

FEATURE_EXTRAPOLATION.flag: held-out policy delta-feature vector has >=1 feature outside the training-manifest min/max for the same policy
FEATURE_EXTRAPOLATION.magnitude: sum outside-range distance / max(training_range,1e-12) across six features

HISTORICAL_SIGN_INSTABILITY.flag: training-manifest actual policy advantages occupy more than one sign class among {-1,0,+1}

DOMAIN_CONTRIBUTION_CONFLICT.flag: main-model predicted domain allocation deltas include at least one positive and one negative nonzero domain contribution

classification_rules.supported: valid and at least one mechanism has coverage>=0.20, flagged sign-error rate >= unflagged + 0.15, and flagged MAE >= unflagged*1.25
classification_rules.mixed: valid and at least one mechanism has both higher flagged sign-error rate and higher flagged MAE than unflagged but misses a supported threshold
classification_rules.negative: valid and no mechanism shows both directional enrichments
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, manifest/model identity, flag definition, training-vs-heldout boundary, outcome ordering, deterministic replay, provenance, capacity or accounting requirement fails

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter manifests, six features, ridge model, policy set, mechanism definitions, sign classes, excursion formula, coverage/error thresholds, evaluator or classification after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: freeze one correction derived from supported causal mechanism and validate it prospectively on a sixth disjoint manifest with equal fallback

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: inspect why identical diagnostic states map to different realized gains without tuning an allocator
